article.headline: Southern Miss opens season with an 82-35 win over Tougaloo
article.description: — Isaac Tavares scored 12 points as Southern Miss opened its season Monday with an 82-35 victory over Tougaloo.
article.linkText: Southern Miss opens season with an 82-35 win over Tougaloo

event.description: Tougaloo Bulldogs @ Southern Miss Golden Eagles

keywords: Tougaloo Bulldogs @ Southern Miss Golden Eagles
article.story: HATTIESBURG, Miss. -- — Isaac Tavares scored 12 points as Southern Miss opened its season Monday with an 82-35 victory over Tougaloo. Tavares added nine rebounds for the Golden Eagles. Cameron Wallace added 11 points while going 5 for 9 from the field and grabbing eight rebounds. Brandon Weston had nine points and shot 2 for 5 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and 3 for 3 from the free-throw line. Derek Hollman Jr. led the Bulldogs with six points and six rebounds. Daveon Johnson added six points for Tougaloo. Ben Radford also finished with six points. Up next Southern Miss visits Iowa State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
